_comment: Configuration for the Lobster Monitor observation record. Forked from the private wedding lobster monitor on 2026-09-24. The wedding record stays where it is and keeps its own schedule; this record starts on the cut date below and is anchored and published (sellers by letter) with Provision Record.
_record_start_note: Observations captured on or after this date are read by tools/issue.py from this record; observations before it come from the private wedding record, cited by hash and commit. A test capture on 2026-09-24 (one source) validated the tooling and is retained but not read by any edition.

CADENCE._comment: Capture days, local time (America/New_York): the 1st and 15th of each month, set by the publication's monthly cycle rather than by any event. launchd fires tools/run-pass.sh on those days.

CAPTURE._render_note: Chrome 152 headless writes the PDF/PNG and then hangs; capture.py bounds each render at render_timeout_seconds and validates the file trailer.
